name: Jupiter Farms Christmas Parade and Craft Fair
when_note: Parade at 11 AM, craft fair 12 to 4 PM, parade awards at 3 PM
paras: The Jupiter Elks Lodge #2469 sponsors the 2026 Jupiter Farms Christmas Parade and Craft Fair on Saturday, December 5, 2026. The parade steps off at 11 AM on 160th Rd N, which the Elks call Rudolph Sighting, starting at 133rd and heading east past Haynie Lane to Randolph Siding. This year's theme is Christmas in the Farms, and the lodge says you do not need to be a member to come along as a guest.

The Holiday Craft Fair follows from 12 to 4 PM at the Elks Lodge in the Jupiter Farms Shopping Center, 10070 W Indiantown Rd. Vendors sell homemade items indoors, in the parking lot and on the grass, refreshments and food are sold, and parade awards are handed out at the lodge at 3 PM. The Elks also run a Holiday Giving Tree, which goes up in mid-November, where parade participants are encouraged to sponsor a local child.
tip: Watch the parade at 11 AM, then walk over for the craft fair and the 3 PM awards.
